hypernetwork.summary: A small network reads the regime of the recent bars and writes the weights of a second network that then reads the current bar.
hypernetwork.implementationNote: The context is the window's per-feature mean and standard deviation; the hypernetwork generates every weight and bias of a one-hidden-layer target perceptron applied to the last bar, so the target network changes with the regime.

sequence_length.label: Sequence length (bars)
sequence_length.description: How many past bars the context (the regime) is measured over for one prediction.

hypernetwork_hidden_size.label: Hypernetwork hidden size
hypernetwork_hidden_size.description: How many units the weight-writing network has in its hidden layer.

target_hidden_size.label: Target hidden size
target_hidden_size.description: How many hidden units the generated target network has; every one of its weights is written by the hypernetwork.

context_embedding_size.label: Context embedding size
context_embedding_size.description: The size the window's mean and standard deviation are compressed to before the weights are written.

dropout.label: Dropout
dropout.description: The share of units switched off at random during training, in the hypernetwork's hidden layer and the target hidden layer.

learning_rate.label: Learning rate
learning_rate.description: How big a step each weight update takes.

weight_decay.label: Weight decay
weight_decay.description: A pull of every weight toward zero, which keeps the network simple.

batch_size.label: Batch size
batch_size.description: How many bars one weight update averages over.

epochs.label: Epochs
epochs.description: How many passes over the training bars at most.

patience.label: Patience (epochs)
patience.description: Stop after this many epochs without a better validation loss; the best epoch is kept.
